init_hook: python -c 'import torch' 2>/dev/null && echo 'devbox: torch present' || echo 'devbox: NOT set up -> run setup-cpu (laptop) or setup-cuda (M6000 box)'

setup-cpu: python -c "import torch; print('torch', torch.__version__, '| cuda', torch.cuda.is_available())"
setup-cuda: uv pip install 'torch==2.7.1' --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu126 || uv pip install 'torch==2.6.0' --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu126
python -c "import torch; print('torch', torch.__version__, '| built for CUDA', torch.version.cuda)"
